scenarios.title: A｜打电话寻找
scenarios.setting: 在“退房后发现遗落物品”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“打电话寻找”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I checked out earlier today, and I think I left something in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I checked out earlier today, and I think I left something in my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I stayed at your hotel last night and may have left an item behind.

feedback.naturalExpression: I stayed at your hotel last night and may have left an item behind.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: I’m calling because I think I forgot something in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling because I think I forgot something in my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I just realized I left something at the hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just realized I left something at the hotel.
feedback.explanation: “just realized”表示刚意识到；“left something at the hotel”说明物品落在酒店，而不是忘记做某事。

turns.text: I’m sorry. What item are you looking for?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a black jacket. I think I left it in the closet.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a black jacket. I think I left it in the closet.
feedback.explanation: “I left it”谈随身物品时可表示遗落；接地点能说明东西可能在哪里。

choices.text: I may have left my phone charger by the bed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have left my phone charger by the bed.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: It’s a small blue bag that was in the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a small blue bag that was in the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: I think I left my headphones on the desk.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left my headphones on the desk.
feedback.explanation: “I left my”谈随身物品时可表示遗落；接地点能说明东西可能在哪里。

turns.text: May I have your name and room number?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Alex Chen, room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: Alex Chen, room 806.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: The reservation was under Alex Chen. I was in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: The reservation was under Alex Chen. I was in room 806.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: I don’t remember the room number, but I checked out this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t remember the room number, but I checked out this morning.
feedback.explanation: “I don't remember”表达自己没有印象，并不直接断言这件事从未发生。

turns.text: I’ll check with housekeeping and lost and found.

turns.prompt: 你想和酒店确认寻找遗失物品的后续联系安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you call me back if you find it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you call me back if you find it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: How long do you think it will take to check?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long do you think it will take to check?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Should I stay on the line, or can someone contact me later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I stay on the line, or can someone contact me later?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

scenarios.title: B｜返回酒店领取
scenarios.setting: 在“退房后发现遗落物品”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“返回酒店领取”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I called earlier about a jacket I left here. I was told it had been found.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I called earlier about a jacket I left here. I was told it had been found.
feedback.explanation: “was told”表示这是此前被告知的信息；交代来源，有助于核对不同说法。

choices.text: I’m here to pick up an item from lost and found.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m here to pick up an item from lost and found.
feedback.explanation: 开头就交代来访或来电目的，帮助对方判断该查询什么、由谁处理。

choices.text: I came back to collect something I left in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I came back to collect something I left in my room.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I’m here for my lost jacket.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I called earlier about a jacket I left here. I was told it had been found.
feedback.explanation: 这句能说明来领外套，但补充之前已联系且酒店确认找到，工作人员更容易接上记录。

turns.text: Of course. May I have your name?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Alex Chen. I was in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: Alex Chen. I was in room 806.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: It’s under Alex Chen. The item is a black jacket.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s under Alex Chen. The item is a black jacket.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: I checked out this morning from room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: I checked out this morning from room 806.
feedback.explanation: “this morning”明确是哪一天的时段，谈当前日期时前面不必加介词。

turns.text: For security purposes, could you describe the item?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a black jacket with a silver zipper.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a black jacket with a silver zipper.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: There’s a red tag inside the collar.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a red tag inside the collar.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: My wallet is still in one of the pockets.

feedback.naturalExpression: My wallet is still in one of the pockets.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: It’s a medium-sized black jacket.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a medium-sized black jacket.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

turns.text: That matches the item we have here.

turns.prompt: 你想确认领取遗失物品需要什么手续，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Do you need to see my ID?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do you need to see my ID?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Perfect. Is there anything I need to sign?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Is there anything I need to sign?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Thank you. I’m glad it was found.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’m glad it was found.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

turns.text: Just sign here to confirm that you’ve collected it.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. Thank you for keeping it safe.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Thank you for keeping it safe.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Done. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Done. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: C｜酒店没有找到
scenarios.setting: 在“退房后发现遗落物品”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“酒店没有找到”。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but housekeeping hasn’t found anything matching that description.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店进一步查找遗失的物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you check again, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check again, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Has the room already been cleaned?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has the room already been cleaned?
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

choices.text: Could you also check with lost and found?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you also check with lost and found?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there anywhere else the item might have been turned in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anywhere else the item might have been turned in?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: We’ve checked the room and lost and found, but nothing has been turned in yet.

turns.prompt: 你想留下联系方式，方便找到物品后通知你，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you keep my contact information in case it turns up later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you keep my contact information in case it turns up later?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you contact me if someone finds it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you contact me if someone finds it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: How long do you normally keep lost property records?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long do you normally keep lost property records?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Should I call back tomorrow to check again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I call back tomorrow to check again?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: Certainly. We’ll make a note and contact you if the item is found.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: All right. I’ll check back tomorrow as well.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I’ll check back tomorrow as well.
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

choices.text: Thanks for looking into it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for looking into it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
